![The task graph: tasks joined by lines that show sub-tasks and what blocks what](/lp/guide/en/graph.webp)

Mark what a task is **Blocked by**. While a blocker is open, Genos sets the task to Blocked. When the last one closes, it goes back to Open.

Open the task graph to see the whole chain.
